label: PAYG instalments automatic entry, individual or trust: instalment income
quote: instalment income from your latest tax return of $4,000 or more
pattern: instalment income from your latest tax return of (\$[\d,]+) or more tax payable
notes: Individuals and trusts enter when all three entry thresholds are met. Companies and super funds use different tests. The page states no start date. These are the ATO's thresholds: Division 45 in Schedule 1 to the Taxation Administration Act 1953 lets the Commissioner give an instalment rate (s 45-15), and no entry threshold was found in it (compilation of 1 April 2026), so the period stays the retrieval date.
